settings.source: User report in this chat, 5 October 2026
settings.user_report: Mostly default settings, edge weights on. A resolution value of 1 was mentioned in connection with PageRank.
settings.note: The user subsequently confirmed PageRank probability 0.85 and epsilon 0.001. Resolution is a Modularity parameter. Unrecorded settings remain unconfirmed; imported centrality values are preserved.

methods.rank_correlation: Pearson correlation of average ranks (Spearman); no p-values
methods.top20: Descending metric, then ascending node ID; ties at cutoff can be excluded
methods.modularity_quality: Weighted undirected Q at gamma=1 for exported labels; opposite directions summed. No community detection rerun. Not an asserted recovery of the Gephi report.
methods.strong_components: Iterative Kosaraju; labels compared as node sets
methods.export_rounding: Gephi centralities are rounded to six decimals; imported values preserved

plots_reused: Existing validated plots retained unchanged during directory reorganization; input hashes unchanged.
